pours.name: Column
pours.says: One closed tube. It measures the foam itself: how much a gram becomes, and when.

pours.name: Comb
pours.says: A pour well at the corner of an L. One leg is cells of five gaps fed from the floor; the other is rooms off the well and two cells fed only over their tops.

pours.name: Tray
pours.says: Half of the bottom cap's foam space, lying flat as the cap is poured: two ports, and a vent at one end only.
